main_body: T-shaped timber prop with horizontal crossbeam and vertical support post
top_band: light tan/ochre top surface of the crossbeam from row 10 to 12, followed by a pale cream front-edge highlight at row 13
evidence: The horizontal top crossbeam clearly shows a 3-row light tan top surface (rows 10-12) plus a 1-row bright cream front-edge highlight (row 13), above a 3-row shaded brown front face (rows 14-16) and dark underside/eave shadow (row 17), with the vertical support post recessed below (rows 18-47) and shaded at its top.

style.evidence: The timber prop uses 6 distinct warm brown/tan shading steps, dark brown material-toned outlines rather than black, and varied wood grain/knot pixel detailing across both the crossbeam and the post, matching the Beodeul reference craft.
